name: Can I sell a probate property 'as-is' in Florida?

mainEntity.name: Can I sell a probate property 'as-is' in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to sell a probate property 'as-is' in Florida. Many executors choose this option to avoid incurring additional costs for repairs or renovations, especially when funds are limited or the property requires extensive work. Selling 'as-is' means the buyer accepts the property in its current condition, which can sometimes lead to a quicker sale, though potentially at a lower price compared to a fully renovated home. It simplifies the preparation process for the executor, who may not have the resources or time for significant property improvements.
